boundary: Only REQUEST.md, task.json, request.json, registry.json, the three admitted source extractions, input/population_metadata.json, the common base_skill and linked harness-interface reference, and these four output files were read. No external literature, target statistics, prior author bundle, other arm or project history was opened.

sources.population: Ghana AWI-Gen Navrongo, 2015, ages 40-60, at least 10 years resident, pregnancy excluded, complete investigated variables; total n=1839. Tables list 846 men/993 women; methods list 864 men, an unresolved discrepancy.
sources.measurement: Measured weight/height BMI kg/m^2; overnight fasting serum lipids on Randox RX Daytona+, mmol/L. No target assay-equivalence evidence.

used.operator: Arithmetic mean and individual SD, sex-stratified, no covariate adjustment
used.uncertainty: Estimate uncertainty not reported; SD is not SE
used.actual_use: Set reference BMI lognormal moment parameters using v=log(1+(SD/mean)^2); approximate reinterpretation at age 50 under A03. Sex means and SDs all used in generator.

used.locator: Results, Mean lipid levels stratified by sex and age category, opening paragraph
used.operator: Pooled arithmetic mean and individual SD, unadjusted
used.actual_use: Set reference lipid lognormal parameters, then add assumed age and transported sex shifts; do not claim resulting marginal or conditional source reproduction.

declined_or_context.reason: Restricted 40-60 source age design is unsuitable as the full adult age distribution. Age 50 is a reference convention; no age SD calibration.
Use sex-specific moments from the same study rather than also treating its pooled moment as independent information.

Reported coefficient and 95% CI use unresolved log base, univariate adjustment and uncertain intercept/weighting. None enters the generator or becomes a raw OLS coefficient; CIs are not used as dispersion.

sources.correction_and_overlap: 2019 correction affects hip/waist and a reference, not selected lipid/BMI/age rows. All selected moments belong to the same dataset; no independent replication claim.

sources.population: Selected African cohorts age>=18, reported pregnancy/HIV-positive/diabetes excluded, observed sex and complete lipids. Selected template is rural Malawi MEIRU; source flags are not available for target exclusion.
sources.measurement: Malawi enzymatic Beckman Coulter laboratory assays, fasting sought but random sample accepted after two unsuccessful fasting attempts; specimen matrix unresolved in extraction. BMI kg/m^2; lipids mmol/L.

used.operator: Unadjusted reported quantiles; sample quantile convention not reported
used.uncertainty: No interval for estimated quantiles; IQR describes persons, not estimation uncertainty
used.actual_use: Interior inverse-CDF knots under an explicitly assumed population-quantile convention, interpolation and transport; endpoints 18 and 90 are assumed. Not a claim of verified empirical quantile replay.

used.locator: Table 2; rural Malawi Total cholesterol and HDL geometric-mean rows
used.actual_use: Compute log female/male ratios log(3.9/3.6)=0.08004270767353636 and log(1.1/1.05)=0.04652001563489291; apply as conditional log shifts by A04. Values are never relabeled as arithmetic means.
used.uncertainty: Rounded 95% CIs retained for provenance only; collapsed interval is not zero variance and does not set precision weights or individual SDs.

declined_or_context.items: All six strata BMI geometric means; urban Malawi and Uganda demographic and lipid summaries
declined_or_context.reason: Read but not used numerically. Native arithmetic BMI SDs are available from Navrongo; arbitrary blending of differing source contexts and estimators is avoided. Urban/rural labels do not identify target lifestyles.

declined_or_context.items: All low-HDL proportions and non-HDL geometric means
declined_or_context.reason: Read but not used for fitting or acceptance; source selection and assay differ, and no source execution adapter is provided. Geometric non-HDL cannot be derived by subtracting geometric TC and HDL.

declined_or_context.items: greiner_table3_context_01 through greiner_table3_context_12, Supplementary DC2 Table 3 pages 3-4
declined_or_context.reason: Unresolved response/predictor scales prohibit numerical calibration; age/smoking/alcohol adjustment cannot be replaced by available age/sex/BMI fields. No coefficient or CI enters the law.

sources.denominators_and_issues: Rural men Table 1/Table 2 group n=4534; rural women 5894/5893. Other table count disagreements remain unresolved. Row-specific n is unknown, source weighting unspecified, no denominator-derived uncertainty or cohort-size pooling. Urban women's HDL CI 1.15-1.26 around printed 1.15 is quarantined and unused. Name-only published correction does not change selected statistics. Original reused artifact path appearing inside the supplied extraction was not opened.
sources.overlap: Age and lipid summaries are dependent observations from the same named cohorts; the reviewed extraction is one source version, not independent confirmations.

sources.population: Ghana, 2013; rural Jachie-Pramso n=360 and urban Kumasi n=312. Household recruitment excludes prior hypertension, diabetes, coronary disease/treatment, pregnancy/lactation and physical/mental disability. Age range and pair-specific n unresolved.
sources.measurement: Measured BMI; 12-14-hour fasting venous serum enzymatic Selectra Pro S lipids mmol/L; assay transport unverified.

used.operator: Unadjusted Spearman correlation; weighting, tie handling and missing-pair policy not explicitly reported
used.uncertainty: Intervals unavailable; BMI-TC p<0.05, other two no star. No missing interval is treated as certainty and no no-star estimate is set to zero.
used.actual_use: Gaussian-copula conversion 2*sin(pi*r_s/6) gives latent correlations [0.22155024842155735,-0.10467191248588766,0.11094596004995781]. A06 explicitly reinterprets them as conditional innovation dependence. They are not directly substituted for target adjusted slopes or Pearson residual correlation.

declined_or_context.reason: Retain as evidence of between-community variation, not pooled independent constraints. No known target mixture justifies rural/urban weighting; a single rural dependence scenario was selected prospectively.

sources.overlap: The three used correlations come from the same community and must form one joint matrix; they are not three studies. Distinct named geography/year from Navrongo/MEIRU; participant-level non-overlap was not audited.

assumptions.summary: Equal sex probability; external age-quantile template and age ceiling; lognormal reference shapes; unconditional moments reinterpreted conditionally; unadjusted geometric sex differences reinterpreted conditionally; assumed age effects; rural unadjusted rank associations reinterpreted as conditional copula; finite tail guard; transfer across populations and assays; fixed scenario without epistemic draws. All are explicit assumptions, not reported target facts.

analyses.construction_link: HDL and BMI share copula innovations; age and sex shifts induce a joint measured distribution. Requested adjusted OLS is a downstream projection.
analyses.status: Assumption-dependent, not directly matched to a source adjusted estimate; not computed on generated data.

analyses.status: Assumption-dependent, not calibrated using Agongo unresolved log regressions; not computed on generated data.

analyses.construction_link: The full positive-definite latent covariance creates shared lipid variation after BMI association. Analytical latent partial correlation is distinct from the requested raw-scale OLS residual correlation.
analyses.status: Assumption-dependent; no published matched Pearson residual correlation and no generated-data estimate.
